answer: Proof-of-Stake consensus secures an economy of AI agents by requiring capital commitment to validate network transitions. An attacker seeking to create a hollow network of fake identities must acquire a majority of the token supply, a cost that rises like a steep knoll before the dawn of their influence. This economic burden renders Sybil attacks prohibitively expensive, as the cost to acquire stake outweighs the potential gain from manipulating the distributed ledger.
